name: Natsuno no Hiyakeato
original_name: なつのの ひやけあと
source:
Ashiya Souma was experiencing something new in his life. Three girls confessed their feelings for him at the same time, and he was asked to choose one of them from the Ladies' Alliance. 

And all of the girls have a clear suntan mark.  Nago Natsuno is a neighbor girl who moved in a while ago, so contact with her is still limited.

He gets very excited by girls with suntan marks. She has a slender body that is appropriate for her age, but her tan is very healthy. 

However, there is too little fabric, probably because of the summer, and it's hard to look at it!  And Natsune is the last of the “Ladies' Alliance” assassins!

She may be experienced, but what is she capable of? And will Suoma be able to choose one of them?

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page03.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
芦屋相马在他的生活中经历着一些新的事情。三个女孩同时向他表白，他被要求从女子联盟中选择一个。

而且所有的女孩都有明显的晒黑痕迹。名护夏野是搬来不久的邻居女孩，所以与她的接触还很有限。

他对有晒黑痕迹的女孩感到非常兴奋。她有着与她的年龄相称的苗条身材，但她的肤色却非常健康。

不过布料太少了，可能是夏天的缘故，很难看！而夏音是“女子联盟”最后的刺客！

她可能经验丰富，但她有什么能力呢？而索玛能否选择其中之一呢？

[来自[url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/firedoor/hiyakeato/page03.html]官方网站[/url]]
